title: Da Lat vs Da Nang: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Da Lat for cool-weather escapism, mountain adventures, and Vietnam's best coffee culture. Da Nang for beaches, modern infrastructure, and a base for Hoi An and Hue.

categories.name: Vibe & Atmosphere
categories.summary: Da Lat's misty pine forests, French villas, and Crazy House give it the more distinctive character.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Da Lat wins on highland coffeehouses. Da Nang wins on fresh seafood volume.

categories.name: Things To Do
categories.summary: Da Lat wins on adventure (canyoning, trekking). Da Nang wins on beach + cultural day trips.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Both run ~$24-48/day mid-range. Da Nang has cheaper dorms; Da Lat slightly cheaper overall.

categories.name: Weather & Climate
categories.summary: Da Lat is 15-25°C year-round. Da Nang is 25-36°C tropical hot with a typhoon season.

categories.name: Where to Stay
categories.summary: Da Nang has wider accommodation range from dorm beds to luxury beach resorts.

categories.name: Transit Access
categories.summary: Da Nang has an international airport and sits on the train line. Da Lat is domestic-only.

categories.name: Digital Nomads
categories.summary: Better Wi-Fi, more co-working spaces, and established expat community.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Hoi An, Hue, My Son, Marble Mountains — Da Nang's day trip menu is exceptional.

faq.question: Is Da Lat or Da Nang better for first-time Vietnam visitors?
faq.answer: Visit both if possible. Da Lat for cool-weather mountains; Da Nang for beaches and Central Vietnam's coastal highlights.

faq.question: How far is Da Lat from Da Nang?
faq.answer: ~500km. About 1 hour by domestic flight or 8-10 hours by overnight bus.

faq.question: Which is cheaper — Da Lat or Da Nang?
faq.answer: Essentially tied at ~$24-48/day mid-range. Da Nang has cheaper hostel dorms.
